entities.name: Raymond Rallier du Baty

entities.summary: Raymond Rallier du Baty was a French sailor and explorer, from Lorient in Brittany, who carried out surveys of the subantarctic Kerguelen Islands in the southern Indian Ocean in the early 20th century.
